head: DeskOS turns your iPhone into a small desktop with files, browser and editors
dek: DeskOS gives your iPhone a desktop-style workspace with files, a browser and photo and video editors, with a keyboard and trackpad on screen. It was #91 among paid Productivity apps on the US App Store on 9 November.
details: On the iPhone Duo, half-opening the phone puts the desktop above the fold and the keyboard below. You can also connect an external display. It costs $11.99 with in-app purchases, by Mazen Al-Ashbi, and needs iOS 17.
where: iPhone and iPhone Duo, App Store, $11.99
means: If you want a laptop-like layout on your phone, especially on the Duo, this is one try.
todo: Find DeskOS in the App Store.
